categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches fuzz harness `src/test/fuzz/torcontrol.cpp` and test utility `src/test/util/net.cpp` with the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Substantially upgrades the `torcontrol` fuzz harness to test wire-level parsing over simulated sockets instead of calling callbacks directly. Author reports line coverage on `src/torcontrol.cpp` increases from 52% to 81% and notes the target reproduces regression #36637 within hundreds of runs, but improving Tor controller fuzz coverage is deferrable.
